text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh...
This is Hana! I met her just now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～
ハナちゃんとはさっき会ったんだ～♪

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Right? She's just the cutest little kid!
You should play with us too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね～、
すご～く
かわいい子だよね～
おにいちゃんも一緒にあそぼ～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're great friends now!
We played together lots! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
とっても仲良しだよ～
一緒に遊んでたんだ～♪

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ♪
We can all be bunnies!
Hippety-hoppety! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん♪
一緒にうさぎさんになろ～
ぴょんぴょ～ん♪
